title: ANALOG TO DIGITAL CONVERTER FOR IMAGE DETECTOR READOUT APPLICATIONS - EXPRO PLUS
description: The introduction of advanced technology nodes (65 nm, 28 nm and 22 nm) enables the development of power efficient, high data rate ADC for image detector readout for space applications. The change in technology from 180 nm to 65 nm and lower CMOS (complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor) nodes results in an over tenfold reduction of power consumption, that has been demonstrated with such advanced ADCs. Correspondingly, the data readout rates, and detector sizes have increased for commercial applications for similar power consumption figures. The aim of this activity is to develop a low power (50 mW), high data rate (50 Mbps), accurate (14 bit), small foot print (0.5 mm) analog to digital converter (ADC) for image detector readout applications. The activity shall radiation harden existing ADCs and improve existing radiation hardened ADCs for the advanced technology nodes, manufacture electrical and radiation test the ADC to a working prototype. Subsequent tasks shall integrate this ADC together with the analog front-end into an integrated circuit dedicated for image detector analog readout and/or integrated detector global/column readout and/or 3D stacked column readout applications.This activity encompasses the following tasks: Analysis of the requirements for analog readout and/or integrated detector global/column readout and/or 3D stacked column readout applications and determination of the specifications for the ADC and front-end. Evaluation of the suitable advanced technologies for the ADC for the identified applications and of the suitable ADC architectures and required image detector readout front-ends for the chosen technologies. Design of the ADC (with a specific image detector readout front-end) to the target specification. Manufacturing of the ADC. Design and manufacture of the evaluation board. Electrical and radiation test and characterisation of the ADC with specific image detector readout front-end. Debugging and realisation of ADC component prototype.
